title: aulomyrcia selloi
intro: Aulomyrcia selloi, commonly known as the Brazilian pepper tree or guava pepper tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. It is native to the subtropical regions of Brazil and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Aulomyrcia selloi include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
